questions.question: Recommend the most suitable financing option based on your analysis. 10a. What are the factors determining the cost of capital? Explain?OR 10b. Two companies, Alpha Ltd. and Beta Ltd., are operating in the same industry. The following financial details are available: Particulars Alpha Ltd. (₹) Beta Ltd. (₹) Sales 40,00,000 40,00,000 Variable Cost 24,00,000 24,00,000 Fixed Cost 10,00,000 6,00,000 Interest 2,00,000 4,00,000 a) Calculate Contribution and EBIT for both companies. b) Compute: • Degree of Operating Leverage (DOL) • Degree of Financial Leverage (DFL) • Degree of Combined Leverage (DCL) c) Compare the Operating Risk of both companies. d) Compare the Financial Risk of both companies. e) Identify which company is more risky overall and justify your answer with appropriate reasoning.
questions.solution_html:
• o Firm G: 2.5 * 1.6 = 4
  • o Firm H: 1.67 *2.0 = 3.34
  • Firm G (2.5) has a higher DOL than Firm H (1.67).
  • Conclusion: Firm G carries higher operating risk due to higher fixed operating costs.
  • Firm H (2.0) has a higher DFL than Firm G (1.6).
  • Conclusion: Firm H carries higher financial risk due to its higher interest burden.
  • Firm G (4.0) is more risky overall compared to Firm H (3.34).
  • Justification: While Firm H has higher debt (financial risk), the significantly higher
  • fixed operating costs in Firm G make it more sensitive to changes in sales. A 1% change
  • in sales for Firm G will result in a 4% change in taxable income, whereas for Fir m H
  • the change is only 3.34%.
